rules: The system's increase contrast setting now brightens dim text and the borders of panels.
The debrief and the unit card now say when a loss was caught in a blast, a called strike or a collapse, bled out, or went down with its carrier.
When the debrief lists several nameless crews of one type, it now tallies what killed them.
fixes: Free play on Bir Tarsha and Umm Zeitoun no longer fails to start with field works switched on.
